verdict.rationale: Docs confirm developers can write custom pieces in TypeScript (a code-based extensibility mechanism), but the evidence never describes an inline 'Code' step where you drop raw JavaScript or Python directly into a flow as a step — the docs only cover building separate reusable pieces, not ad-hoc code steps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an inline Code/Python step usable within a flow builder, evidence of Python support at all, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
